module: Supply Chain Resiliency (Oracle EBS APPS views)
description: Governed Oracle E-Business Suite views for hub inventory exposure, SLA reservation locks, consumption velocity, inbound purchase order risk, approved suppliers, and open planner workflow alerts. Oracle EBS is the system of record for every quantity, reservation, purchase order, supplier, and notification. VoltGuard's hubs are the organization codes MIA, ATL, DAL, ORD, PHX, and EWR. Query these views with the ebs_execute_sql tool.

tables.description: One row per active item and inventory organization (hub) with raw on-hand, SLA-reserved, available-to-transact (ATT), and safety stock quantities.

columns.name: UNIT_LIST_PRICE_USD
columns.description: Item list price per unit in USD. Oracle Cost Management holds no item cost for these items, so a transfer protects revenue at this price.

columns.name: RAW_ONHAND_QTY
columns.description: Total on-hand quantity across all subinventories, including non-reservable ones.

columns.name: SLA_RESERVED_QTY
columns.description: Quantity locked by reservations for SLA customer demand.

columns.name: SAFETY_STOCK_QTY
columns.description: Safety stock quantity from the latest effective MTL_SAFETY_STOCKS record.

columns.name: BASELINE_SAFETY_STOCK_QTY
columns.description: Baseline safety stock: the latest effective safety stock that the agent didn't set, which surge targets start from. NULL when only the agent has set the hub's safety stock for the item.

columns.name: AVAILABLE_TO_TRANSACT_QTY
columns.description: ATT: on-hand in reservable subinventories minus SLA-reserved quantity, floored at zero. The only quantity a hub can release for transfer.

tables.description: One row per inventory reservation with the SLA customer, contract tier, breach penalty, and reserved quantity that block a hub from releasing stock.

columns.name: ORGANIZATION_CODE
columns.description: Hub organization code holding the reservation.

columns.name: SALES_ORDER_NUMBER
columns.description: Sales order number when the reservation belongs to an order.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_PARTY_NAME
columns.description: SLA customer that owns the reservation.

columns.name: BREACH_PENALTY_USD
columns.description: Contractual penalty in USD for breaching the reservation.

columns.name: RESERVED_QTY
columns.description: Reserved quantity in the primary unit of measure.

columns.name: REQUIREMENT_DATE
columns.description: Date the customer requires the reserved stock.

columns.name: SUBINVENTORY_CODE
columns.description: Subinventory that holds the reserved stock.

tables.description: Trailing 7-day sales order and internal order issue velocity from MTL_MATERIAL_TRANSACTIONS and MRP planning attributes per hub and item. Transfers, subinventory moves, and adjustments never count. BASELINE_DAILY_BURN_QTY is NULL when Oracle EBS recorded no such issues in the last 7 days.

columns.name: BASELINE_DAILY_BURN_QTY
columns.description: Average daily issued quantity over the trailing 7 days.

columns.name: STATIC_MRP_LEAD_TIME_DAYS
columns.description: Item full lead time in days used by MRP.

columns.name: PLANNED_MRP_ORDER_QTY
columns.description: Quantity of uncancelled planned orders in the hub's latest completed MRP plan.

columns.name: NEXT_MRP_DOCK_DATE
columns.description: Earliest dock date of those planned orders.

tables.description: One row per open shipment of an approved standard purchase order, with supplier, dates, and supply risk attributes. Cancelled, closed, and fully received shipments are not inbound supply and don't appear. CORRIDOR_DELAY_DAYS, PLANT_BUFFER_DAYS, and LINE_STOP_EXPOSURE_USD come from the purchase order header descriptive flexfield.

columns.name: OPEN_QTY
columns.description: Quantity still to receive on the shipment: ordered minus received minus cancelled.

columns.name: UNIT_PRICE
columns.description: Unit price in the purchase order currency (CURRENCY_CODE).

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency of the purchase order (for example, USD, EUR).

columns.name: NEED_BY_DATE
columns.description: Date the hub needs the shipment.

columns.name: PROMISED_DATE
columns.description: Date the supplier promised the shipment.

columns.name: CORRIDOR_DELAY_DAYS
columns.description: Current inbound freight corridor delay in days.

columns.name: PLANT_BUFFER_DAYS
columns.description: Days of delay the receiving plant can absorb.

columns.name: LINE_STOP_EXPOSURE_USD
columns.description: Financial exposure in USD if the delay stops the line.

tables.description: Approved supplier list entries per item and hub that Oracle Purchasing can order from (Approved status, enabled and active supplier, active purchasing site), with the item list price that prices a purchase requisition.

columns.name: SUPPLIER_SITE_CODE
columns.description: Supplier site that ships the item.

columns.name: ASL_STATUS
columns.description: Approved supplier list status, such as Approved.

columns.name: LIST_PRICE_USD
columns.description: Item list price in USD for a requisition.

tables.description: Open VoltGuard resiliency alerts (Oracle Workflow message VOLTGUARD_RESILIENCY_ALERT) with the item, hub, purchase order, and severity stored as notification attributes. An alert that is missing from this view doesn't exist, isn't a VoltGuard alert, or is already closed.

columns.name: RECIPIENT_ROLE
columns.description: Planner role that owns the alert.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Notification status, always OPEN in this view.

columns.name: RELATED_PO_NUMBER
columns.description: Purchase order linked to the alert.

common_joins.description: Alert to the hub inventory it concerns
Alert to its delayed purchase order
Hub availability to the SLA reservations that lock it
Hub item to its approved suppliers
Hub item to its requisition lines

example_queries.description: Read the context of an open planner alert
example_queries.sql: SELECT notification_id, subject, recipient_role, item_code, organization_code, related_po_number, alert_severity, begin_date, due_date FROM APPS.VW_SCM_OPEN_NOTIFICATIONS WHERE notification_id = :notification_id

example_queries.description: Attention scan inputs: available stock, safety stock, baseline safety stock, and MRP lead time for every item at every hub
example_queries.sql: SELECT b.organization_code, b.item_code, b.available_to_transact_qty, n.safety_stock_qty, n.baseline_safety_stock_qty, b.static_mrp_lead_time_days FROM APPS.VW_SCM_BURN_RATE_AND_MRP b JOIN APPS.VW_SCM_NET_AVAILABILITY n ON n.organization_code = b.organization_code AND n.item_code = b.item_code WHERE b.organization_code IN ('MIA', 'ATL', 'DAL', 'ORD', 'PHX', 'EWR') ORDER BY b.organization_code, b.item_code

example_queries.description: Net availability of an item across every hub
example_queries.sql: SELECT organization_code, organization_name, raw_onhand_qty, sla_reserved_qty, available_to_transact_qty, safety_stock_qty, baseline_safety_stock_qty, unit_list_price_usd FROM APPS.VW_SCM_NET_AVAILABILITY WHERE item_code = :item_code ORDER BY organization_code

example_queries.description: SLA reservations that lock an item at each hub
example_queries.sql: SELECT organization_code, customer_party_name, sla_contract_tier, reserved_qty, breach_penalty_usd, requirement_date FROM APPS.VW_SCM_SLA_CONTRACT_LOCKS WHERE item_code = :item_code ORDER BY organization_code

example_queries.description: Classify source hubs that can release a transfer quantity without breaching SLA reservations
example_queries.sql: SELECT organization_code, organization_name, available_to_transact_qty, unit_list_price_usd, CASE WHEN available_to_transact_qty >= :transfer_qty THEN 'SLA_COMPLIANT' ELSE 'SLA_LOCKED' END AS sla_status FROM APPS.VW_SCM_NET_AVAILABILITY WHERE item_code = :item_code AND organization_code <> :dest_org_code ORDER BY available_to_transact_qty DESC

example_queries.description: Delay details of a purchase order
example_queries.sql: SELECT po_number, item_code, item_description, organization_code, ordered_qty, unit_price, currency_code, need_by_date, promised_date, supplier_name, corridor_delay_days, plant_buffer_days, line_stop_exposure_usd FROM APPS.VW_SCM_ACTIVE_POS WHERE po_number = :po_number

example_queries.description: Recommended requisition quantity: 0 when another hub has surplus stock (ATT above safety stock) to transfer. Otherwise scale the destination's baseline safety stock by the search surge multiplier (NULL, without a matching search, counts as 1), then subtract its available stock and the quantity on its open requisitions that aren't on a purchase order yet, never below zero
example_queries.sql: SELECT organization_code, item_code, safety_stock_qty, baseline_safety_stock_qty, available_to_transact_qty, network_surplus_qty, open_requisition_qty, CASE WHEN network_surplus_qty > 0 THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(CEIL(baseline_safety_stock_qty * NVL(:search_surge_multiplier, 1)) - available_to_transact_qty - open_requisition_qty, 0) END AS recommended_requisition_qty FROM (SELECT n.organization_code, n.item_code, n.safety_stock_qty, n.baseline_safety_stock_qty, n.available_to_transact_qty, (SELECT NVL(SUM(GREATEST(x.available_to_transact_qty - x.safety_stock_qty, 0)), 0) FROM APPS.VW_SCM_NET_AVAILABILITY x WHERE x.item_code = n.item_code AND x.organization_code <> n.organization_code) AS network_surplus_qty, (SELECT NVL(SUM(l.quantity), 0) FROM PO_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL l JOIN PO_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL h ON h.requisition_header_id = l.requisition_header_id WHERE l.destination_organization_id = n.organization_id AND l.item_id = n.inventory_item_id AND h.authorization_status IN ('APPROVED', 'IN PROCESS', 'PRE-APPROVED') AND NVL(l.cancel_flag, 'N') = 'N' AND NVL(l.closed_code, 'OPEN') = 'OPEN' AND l.line_location_id IS NULL) AS open_requisition_qty FROM APPS.VW_SCM_NET_AVAILABILITY n WHERE n.organization_code = :org_code AND n.item_code = :item_code)

example_queries.description: Open requisitions for an item at a hub that aren't on a purchase order yet
example_queries.sql: SELECT h.segment1 AS requisition_number, h.authorization_status, l.quantity, l.unit_price AS unit_price_usd, l.suggested_vendor_name, l.need_by_date, h.creation_date FROM PO_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL l JOIN PO_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL h ON h.requisition_header_id = l.requisition_header_id JOIN APPS.VW_SCM_NET_AVAILABILITY n ON n.organization_id = l.destination_organization_id AND n.inventory_item_id = l.item_id WHERE n.organization_code = :org_code AND n.item_code = :item_code AND h.authorization_status IN ('APPROVED', 'IN PROCESS', 'PRE-APPROVED') AND NVL(l.cancel_flag, 'N') = 'N' AND NVL(l.closed_code, 'OPEN') = 'OPEN' AND l.line_location_id IS NULL ORDER BY h.creation_date

example_queries.description: Approved supplier and list price of an item at a hub
example_queries.sql: SELECT supplier_name, supplier_site_code, supplier_city, supplier_state, asl_status, list_price_usd FROM APPS.VW_SCM_APPROVED_SUPPLIERS WHERE organization_code = :org_code AND item_code = :item_code AND asl_status = 'Approved'
